about: Referral ladder for an app that runs both kits: a milestone on the referral kit's referral_joined event (one per friend who started using the app), rewarded at 1, 3 and 10 friends with modest rewards stated up front; no head start, and each user's own off switch applies. Goal gradient: effort rises as a reward gets near (Kivetz, Urminsky & Zheng 2006). No referral-specific test of reward tiers exists (Robinhood-style ladders are an option, not a proven default), so this preset is off unless the app imports it.
